title: Ejaz Bukhari Method (EBM) Curriculum & Assessment JSON Schema Specification
description: The authoritative JSON specification and comprehensive scenario repository for all curriculum modules, drills, diagnostic tests, and interactive assessments.

instructions.overview: Curriculum JSON files represent structured courses containing reading material, metadata, and ordered question items categorized into sections.

rootProperties.title: Required string. Name of the curriculum unit or assessment.
rootProperties.subject: Required string. Must be 'MATH', 'ENGLISH', 'SCIENCE', or a custom subject string.
rootProperties.gradeLevel: Optional string. Target education level (e.g. 'Grade 1', 'Grade 2', 'Grade 5', 'O Level'). Default: 'Grade 2'.
rootProperties.unitTitle: Optional string. Sub-topic or chapter title.
rootProperties.skillFocus: Optional string. Summary of skills practiced (e.g. 'Quick Addition, Fractions, Data Handling').
rootProperties.lifeConnection: Optional string. Real-world application of the material.
rootProperties.duration: Optional number. Recommended completion duration in minutes.
rootProperties.content: Optional string (Markdown). Notes, instructions, or reading comprehension passage.
rootProperties.thumbnailUrl: Optional string. Image URL for the course card.
rootProperties.questions: Required array of Question objects (1 to 100+ items).

questionProperties.id: Optional string. Unique ID (auto-generated if omitted).
questionProperties.questionNumber: Required string. The sequential or original number (e.g. '1', '21', '79', '80').
questionProperties.sectionTitle: Optional string. Category or part heading (e.g. 'Part A: Quick Addition', 'Part J: Data Handling'). Creates distinct visual dividers in the app.
questionProperties.context: Optional string. Reference data table, chart, or passage linked to this question or group of questions.
questionProperties.question: Required string. The problem stem, prompt, equation, or instruction.
questionProperties.options: Array of strings. Required if type is 'MCQ'. Contains clean choices without letter prefixes (e.g. ['Circle', 'Triangle', 'Square'] or ['½', '⅓', '¼']).
questionProperties.correctAnswer: Required string. The canonical correct answer.
questionProperties.acceptedAnswers: Optional array of strings. List of valid variations (e.g. ['½', '1/2', '0.5'] or ['14', '14 fruits']).

dos: DO group questions logically using 'sectionTitle' (e.g., 'Part A: Quick Addition', 'Part B: Quick Subtraction').
DO use 'context' for data handling tables or stimuli shared across multiple questions so the table appears cleanly above them.
DO provide clean options in 'options' without prepending letters like 'A.' or 'B.' (the application renders badge letters automatically).
DO use 'acceptedAnswers' for equivalent forms of numbers, units, and unicode fractions (e.g. ['½', '1/2', '0.5']).
DO use type 'ACTIVITY' for drawing, coloring, and practical exercises where teacher grading is intended.
DO ensure all question numbers are strings and match worksheet numbering 1-to-1.
donts: DON'T put letter prefixes inside the 'options' strings (e.g. DO NOT write ['A. Red', 'B. Blue']; write ['Red', 'Blue']).
DON'T leave the 'options' array empty when type is 'MCQ'.
DON'T put multi-sentence reasoning in 'correctAnswer'; keep it concise and use accepted variations.
DON'T embed raw HTML tags like <div> or <font> inside question strings; use plain text or markdown.
DON'T leave unclosed quotes or trailing commas that invalidate JSON syntax.

# Mental Maths & Data Handling Drill 58

Welcome to Drill 58. Complete all 10 parts.

### Skills Overview:
- **Part A:** Quick Addition (1–10)
- **Part B:** Quick Subtraction (11–20)
- **Part C:** Choose the Correct Fraction (21–30)
- **Part D:** Circle the Correct Shape (31–40)
- **Part E:** Missing Numbers (41–50)
- **Part F:** Number Comparisons (51–60)
- **Part G:** Doubles & Halves (61–70)
- **Part H:** Practical Activities (71–75)
- **Part I:** Word Problems (76–78)
- **Part J:** Data Handling & Tables (79–80)
